_comment: Admin UI translations. Keys are the English source string shown in the admin; the value is its translation for that language code. Built-in Swedish (sv) ships in the binary — entries here OVERRIDE or EXTEND it, and you can add any language code (de, ar, fr, …). Right-to-left languages (ar, he, fa, …) automatically mirror the whole layout. Missing strings fall back to English. Data (record contents) is never translated here; field/value labels live in the view editor.
